'''Green Three''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the third member of Green Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Green Three.

==History==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Adam Swiftgale]] used this call sign during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]].<ref name="SWI146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref>

As Green Three, [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] with the Alliance's [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE" />

[[6 ABY/Legends|Two and a half years]] after the Battle of Endor, [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilot [[Rhysati Ynr]] used the call sign Green Three in a simulation of the [[Redemption scenario|''Redemption'' scenario]] while training to qualify for membership in the reformed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="XWRS" />

A pilot designated Green Three on patrol over [[Pinnacle Base]] encountered the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Defiance (MC90 Star Cruiser)|''Defiance'']], returning from a reconnaissance mission to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] in which it had sustained damage to its transponder, preventing the ship from broadcasting its identification codes.<ref name="DEa">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>
